summary: Full end-to-end testing of ABYNS KOS (backend + frontend). 13 backend pytest tests, all passing after minor fix to health-components assertion (backend uses object-keys shape not list). Frontend Playwright covered Landing, Dashboard (all cards), Sidebar nav, Properties list + detail with 24 rooms, Tenants (19 rows) + search + detail nav, Billing (19 invoices + filters paid=13/pending=3/overdue=3), Maintenance 3 columns, Finance (Revenue/Expense text present), AI Assistant streaming Gemini response in Indonesian and reset. Everything works as expected.

minor.issue: health object uses keys (occupancy, payments, maintenance, revenue, tenant_experience, overall) instead of an explicit 'components' array. Matches requirement of 5 components but consumers must destructure keys. No functional bug.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' emitted for ResponsiveContainer on initial mount; charts still render but console is noisy. Consider setting minWidth/minHeight or fixed aspect.

action_items: Optional: Wrap Recharts ResponsiveContainer with minHeight or use aspect to eliminate initial -1 width warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single monolithic file — acceptable for prototype but flag for future split (routes/services/models).
Tenants row navigation depends on inner <a> link (not row-level onClick) — works but tests clicking the row element itself won't navigate. Not a bug; documented for future testing agents.
AI SSE stream correctly returns text/event-stream with session + delta + done events; Indonesian keywords present in output.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from all responses (no ObjectId serialization errors observed).
seed_data_creation: None - backend auto-seeds on startup (24 rooms, 19 tenants, 6 expenses, 6-month history) and this was verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at BASE/api/v1 (not /api). AI endpoint returns SSE - use requests stream=True and read iter_lines. Tenant row navigation must click the inner <a> element, not the row div. Data expected: 24 rooms, 19 tenants, 6 expenses, revenue_change_pct=12.4, filter counts paid=13/pending=3/overdue=3. Dashboard health uses object keys (occupancy/payments/maintenance/revenue/tenant_experience/overall) not an array.
